description: This file defines a PHP class `Filter` within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class manages the filtering functionality for product categories, handling request parameters, loading models and language resources, and generating filter data for views.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for handling product category filtering within OpenCart, including request parsing, model interactions, and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that processes the category filtering request, gathers filter data, and returns the rendered filter view or an empty string if no category information is found.
